fitting: Two folds of whole customer trajectories. Estimate transition and observed-state propensity tables on the other fold. Eligibility prohibits assistance in state zero.
targeting: Backward weighted logistic intercept fluctuation after scaling continuation rewards into their exact bounds; solve each cumulative-weight residual equation on the evaluation fold.
uncertainty: Trajectory influence-score covariance for augmentation and targeting, including policy contrast covariance. Direct and IPS are point-estimation comparators only; estimated propensities make their simple observation variance insufficient for full inference.
precision: 500 repetitions; MC SE near .95 is .0097. All failures remain in the denominator.
